messages.progress_guardian: [Progress Guardian] This turn has reached {inv_count} consecutive model invocations. Sync your progress in native update_steps (or task.md if present). Unless the user explicitly requested uninterrupted end-to-end execution (e.g. /goal), wrap up the current submodule at a safe boundary, output a plain-language milestone progress card in the user's language (overall progress, completed work, verification status, next milestone), and pause for user confirmation.
messages.progress_reminder: [Progress Reminder] You have run {interval} consecutive silent tool-calling invocations without updating progress ({elapsed} elapsed; recent actions: {summary}). Before calling more tools, either update native progress via update_focus/update_steps or output one concise status sentence in visible response text (not inside thinking) in the user's language so the user can follow progress in real time.
